name: Fire Shield
notes: Shield absorbs up to 110/140/170/200 HP of incoming damage (level-1 values used). Duration 15s → ceil(15/5) = 3 turns. Dispellable=false (it is a buff on ally). If shield HP reaches 0 before duration: explosion deals 110-200 Magic damage to all enemies in opposite row. In engine: Shield flag causes damage to reduce shield_hp first; when shield_hp=0, trigger explosion event. explodes_on_break and shield_hp are extension fields.
